feature: Laporan hasil submit Unclaimed Reminder (Excel per submit, link download 24 jam, status per notice)
note: Setiap submit-unclaimed menghasilkan laporan Excel berisi hasil per notice dan response berisi link dengan expiresAt 24 jam; endpoint download POST /v1/submit-unclaimed/report/{reportId}. Tidak disebut di OCMS20.1-20.5; mungkin tercakup story OCMS20.x lain (misal 20.20 summary), perlu dicek chunk lain.
note_en: Every submit-unclaimed produces an Excel report with the result per notice and the response carries a link with a 24-hour expiresAt; download endpoint POST /v1/submit-unclaimed/report/{reportId}. Not mentioned in OCMS20.1-20.5; it may be covered by another OCMS20.x story (e.g. 20.20 summary), to be checked by another chunk.

feature: Aturan TS-ACR pada alur DataHive UEN (firma deregistered, UEN tidak ditemukan, alamat kosong, data wajib kosong)
note: storeUenDataResult menerapkan TS-ACR untuk firma deregistered, UEN tidak ditemukan, alamat 3 field kunci kosong, serta nama/tipe/status entitas kosong. Berlaku untuk notice reguler (bukan antrean adhoc Unclaimed). Tidak ada di teks OCMS20.1-20.5; kemungkinan tercakup story epic DataHive/ACRA lain.
note_en: storeUenDataResult applies TS-ACR for a deregistered firm, UEN not found, the 3 key address fields empty, and empty entity name/type/status. It applies to regular notices (not the Unclaimed adhoc queue). Not in the text of OCMS20.1-20.5; probably covered by another DataHive/ACRA epic story.
